text:
Elena M.: hey @Owen quick heads-up — ran a light link-scan and it flagged two broken anchors in kb/serving/runtime-config.md. can someone pick this up?

docs-bot: LinkCheck: 2 broken anchors detected in /kb/serving/runtime-config.md — https://internal.linkcheck/scan/7954321000 :mag:

Owen: thanks — can you paste the anchors or the grep output? i'll try to do a small PR later today.

Elena M.: sure — anchors found: `#kv-cache-optimizations` (should be `#kv-cache-optimization`) and `#compilation-kernels` (doesn't exist). quick grep I ran: `rg "kv-cache-optim" kb/serving/runtime-config.md` showed the old anchor only.

Owen: cool. sounds like a rename + alias/redirect. i'll prepare a tiny PR to rename the header and add frontmatter redirect_from for the old anchor. estimate ~10m.

Julia: i can review after lunch. if it's just header tweak + redirect we don't need infra changes. also check downstream links so we don't leave any references broken.

Elena M.: good call — product onboarding references the old anchor, fyi. @Kevin heads up so you can adjust if needed.

Kevin: noted — i'll patch the onboarding page once the PR is up, or add a follow-up commit.

Owen: opened PR #7954321015 — summary: rename headers + add frontmatter redirect for `#kv-cache-optimizations`. diff snippet in PR: ```diff
- ## KV cache optimizations
+ ## KV cache optimization
---
+ redirect_from: ["/kb/serving/runtime-config#kv-cache-optimizations"]
```

Elena M.: :thumbsup: can someone add `docs-owners` label and assign? i'll smoke test staging preview after merge.

Julia: added label and assigned to @Owen. quick QA checklist: 1) search site for `#kv-cache-optimizations` and confirm no unresolved refs 2) validate staging preview anchors 3) run the link-checker job.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: build 7954321015 -> staging by Owen — https://ci.internal/builds/7954321015 :rocket:

Owen: merge done. staging preview looks clean, aliases resolve to new anchor. i'll follow up with a backport to main branch and a tiny changelog note.

Elena M.: closing loop — staging verified, thanks everyone :tada:

Kevin: thanks — i'll update onboarding in the next commit.

Julia: thx, nice quick turnaround.

docs-bot: Reminder: run nightly link-scan tomorrow to catch any missed refs.
